componentSpecs.name: ILeavePolicyRepository
componentSpecs.description: Repository interface for LeavePolicy persistence. Defines: findById(id: number): Promise<LeavePolicy | null>, findByLeaveType(leaveType: LeaveType): Promise<LeavePolicy[]>, findActivePolicies(params?: LeavePolicyQueryParams): Promise<LeavePolicy[]>, create(policy: Omit<LeavePolicy, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>): Promise<LeavePolicy>, update(id: number, policy: Partial<Omit<LeavePolicy, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>>): Promise<LeavePolicy | null>, delete(id: number): Promise<boolean>. All methods are async and return Promises. Located at src/modules/policy/policy.repository.ts.

componentSpecs.name: LeavePolicyRepository
componentSpecs.description: Concrete implementation of ILeavePolicyRepository using the pg Pool. Constructor accepts an optional Pool parameter (defaults to the shared pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts) enabling test injection. Uses snake_case column names in SQL queries (leave_policies table, columns: policy_name, leave_type, entitlement_days, accrual_rate, max_accumulation, minimum_notice_days, requires_manager_approval, is_active, allow_negative_balance, max_consecutive_days, fiscal_year, created_at, updated_at) mapping to camelCase TypeScript interface fields. The update method builds dynamic SET clauses from provided partial fields and sets updated_at = NOW(). The delete method returns boolean based on rowCount. Located at src/modules/policy/policy.repository.ts.
